SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q14. For the following distribution:
Class: 0-5  5-10  10-15  15-20  20-25
Frequency: 10  15  12  20  9
The sum of the lower limits of the median and modal class is:
(a) 15
(b) 25
(c) 30
(d) 35

Answer / Solution:
Total N = 66, N/2 = 33.
Cumulative frequency crosses 33 in class 10-15 => median class lower limit = 10.
Highest frequency is 20 in class 15-20 => modal class lower limit = 15.
Sum = 10 + 15 = 25
Answer: (b) 25
